spans.s:
गौधार गौधार, अस्, m. (fr. गोधा), an
Iguana (considered as the offspring of the alligator on
account of its smaller size and similar shape); also
गौधेय and गौधेर.

गौधेरक, अस्, m. a kind of small venomous
animal.

गौधूम गौधूम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गो-धूम),
coming from wheat, made of it.

गौधूम्र गौधूम्र, a various reading for
गौतम, q. v.
